description: A read-only probe that reports the live Matters header, the last named column letter, the next free column letter and any duplicate headers.
why_it_exists: A column addition was planned against the n8n cached node schema rather than the sheet and would have targeted the wrong letter. This probe exists so the target column is chosen from the live header row (2026-08-21).
assertions: Trailing blank header cells are stripped before the last-named column is computed, so a widened grid does not push the next free column too far right.
The column letter conversion is base-26 and correct past Z (column 27 is AA).
duplicate_headers lists any non-blank header name that appears more than once - two columns with the same name make every by-name Sheets write ambiguous.
The probe issues a single GET and writes nothing.
target_unresolved_reason: Administrative / QA-infrastructure workflow. No WF1-WF5/WF9 Code node implements it.
